svg.title: Manifest — a human-directed music video workflow
svg.desc: Alan develops lyrics and creative direction with ChatGPT, generates and iterates music in Suno, processes in Ableton and masters with Ozone 11. ChatGPT reference art and first frames guide Gemini or Flow animation. Shotcut or DaVinci assemble clips against the song. Optional Kaiber beat sync precedes Descript, which receives Subtitle Edit SRT timing and optional transparent caption art. Proposed captioned and clean exports enter an unfinished custom Aniflow pipeline for frame extraction, 4K upscaling and reconstruction. FFmpeg restores the final Ableton master audio to each delivery.

svg.text: A song, a world, and the creative choices connecting them.
Mostly original lyrics; optional AI formatting, touch-ups and a few selected suggestions.
BUILD A WORLD, THEN ANIMATE IT
Song duration informs a loose scene plan. Build in roughly 8–10-second clips; trim and rearrange.
Try the scene in either interface
Revise until the take feels right
Arrange and trim against the song
Minimal cuts; return for more takes
Use the final audio and lyrics
Place and style captions from SRT
Text as image artwork; animation explored.
Extract frames → AI upscale to 4K → reassemble video
Preserve picture timing; review the actual output
Generic AI upscaler: specific engine still to be selected / confirmed.
Solid: described working process Dashed gold: optional or unfinished
Manual handoffs + creative loops throughout. Caption variants are proposed; final 4K exports are not verified.
*Kaiber name inferred from spoken “Kyber”; exact phone editor branding to confirm. Tool names identify the workflow.
